_readme: Authoring rules for scripts/generate-questions.ts (MCQ standard v0.1). 'settled' rules are enforced. Anything under switches_pending_jade is OFF until Ian confirms it with Jade; flip the boolean, no code change needed. Pass --rules <path> to use a different file.
_units_note: Caribbean / Trinidad and Tobago practice reports blood glucose in mg/dL, not mmol/L (Ian, 2026-10-05). glucose-mmol rejects any glucose value given in mmol/L. Electrolytes are not covered by this rule.
_negative_stem_note: Negative-stem items (needs further teaching / NOT / EXCEPT) set "format": "negative": the key is typed correct and the three true statements not_asked (Ian, 2026-10-08). The generator still writes positive stems only.
_abbreviation_allowlist_note: Which abbreviations count as universal is still Ian's call. Only matters when enforce_abbreviation_rule is true; otherwise unexpanded abbreviations are logged as warnings.
_store_option_types_note: Set true only after the question_options.distractor_type column exists on the target database (staging migration first).
